'''Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)''' is a Japanese edition of the [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]], released in 1997.<ref name="encyclopedia">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. Page 44.</ref>

== Packaging ==
The product contains two preconstructed 60-card decks, a booster pack, and a Japanese rulebook.<ref name="encyclopedia" />
